digest.component_or_area: code-review gate / LLM runner model routing
propositions: Every code-review step declaration of per-step model class is silently ignored at runtime; all steps resolve to cfg.model despite declaring frontier or standard
PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config.model and uses only the model from self._config (the runner's floor), making per-step configuration ineffective one layer below declaration resolution
Step 0 requires adding step id and declared model class to usage_log records via ContextVar threading so per-step attribution and model-class tracking become observable in REBAR_USAGE_LOG output

The fix must substitute req.config.model into a copy of the runner's config when a request declares a different model, before resolution and downstream provider session construction, keeping all model-adjacent logic coherent
